scope: Prevent readers from observing a partial local 15-minute or 5-minute Parquet archive while a cache refresh publishes it. This changes only local cache publication; it has no model, candidate, admission, portfolio, exchange, or order authority.

causality.data: The writer materialises the received local frame to a same-directory temporary Parquet then atomically replaces the final name. It does not fetch, impute, synthesize, alter, or remove OHLCV rows.
causality.consumer: Concurrent readers observe either the old complete Parquet or the new complete Parquet. A partial header/footer cannot become a source value or a candidate feature.
causality.authority: This implementation has no score, model, admission, portfolio, order, or exchange-write authority.

commands: isolated temporary-directory save/read assertion via hf_data_loader._save_data
validation.results: The isolated writer validation saved two 15-minute rows, read the final Parquet successfully, and verified that no temporary file remained. The broader market-data contract suite was stopped after its unrelated import initialization stalled; it was not treated as passing.
